label: Coder
description: Code implementation, review, debugging, refactoring, and tests.

classification.summary: Use when the request is primarily about source code, tests, diffs, implementation, or refactoring.

label: Architect
description: System design, API design, technical planning, and tradeoff analysis.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about system design, architecture evaluation, API contracts, infrastructure planning, or technical tradeoffs.

label: Security
description: Security review, threat modeling, abuse/risk analysis.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about vulnerabilities, threat modeling, auth, permissions, secrets, privacy, or security policy.
negativeSignals: general code quality without security focus

label: Researcher
description: Search, compare, synthesize, cite, and summarize information.

classification.summary: Use when the answer depends on current external information, web sources, document comparison, fact checking, or literature review.
negativeSignals: the answer is fully in local context

label: Writer
description: Write, edit, summarize, explain, and structure prose.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about writing, editing, summarizing, structuring prose, documentation, release notes, or style improvement.

label: Operator
description: Runtime, deployment, logs, diagnostics, and operational response.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about runtime, deployment, configuration, installation, diagnostics, incidents, or operational work.

label: Analyst
description: Structured analysis, metrics, comparison, prioritization, and decision support.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about structured analysis, comparison, evaluation, prioritization, metrics, risk assessment, or decision support.

label: Planner
description: Breaks goals into requirements, milestones, phased plans, and acceptance criteria.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about breaking goals into requirements, milestones, roadmaps, sprint plans, acceptance criteria, or rollout plans.

label: Tester
description: Test design, QA, validation, reproduction, and end-to-end verification.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about test design, QA, validation, reproduction, regression testing, E2E testing, or acceptance testing.

label: Data
description: Data modeling, query analysis, schema review, transformation, and data quality.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about data modeling, query analysis, schema review, transformation, data quality, or visualization.

label: Product
description: Product requirements, user workflows, prioritization, and release readiness.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about product requirements, user workflows, feature prioritization, release readiness, or user stories.

label: Designer
description: Interface design, interaction design, visual review, and experience quality.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about interface design, interaction design, visual direction, prototyping, design systems, accessibility review, or UI polish.

label: Support

label: Legal
description: Legal, licensing, compliance, terms, and policy interpretation support.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about legal review, licensing, terms, privacy, compliance, contract summary, or policy drafting.

label: Finance
description: Cost, budget, pricing, ROI, billing, and financial comparison work.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about cost estimation, budget planning, financial forecasting, pricing, ROI, or procurement cost analysis.

label: Creative
description: Ideation, naming, visual direction, storytelling, and creative variants.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about ideation, naming, visual direction, storytelling, copywriting, brand voice, or creative concept development.

label: Educator

classification.summary: Use when the request is about teaching, tutoring, curriculum design, lesson planning, quiz generation, learning feedback, or concept explanation.

label: Translator
description: Translation, localization, tone transfer, and multilingual communication.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about translation, localization, tone adaptation, glossary creation, or multilingual communication.

label: Marketer
description: Positioning, messaging, campaigns, SEO, content strategy, and audience research.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about positioning, campaign planning, SEO content, ad copy, audience research, messaging review, or launch planning.

label: Seller

classification.summary: Use when the request is about sales discovery, outreach, enterprise proposals, objection handling, account planning, demos, or follow-ups.

label: Recruiter
description: Job descriptions, interview plans, hiring rubrics, and candidate screening support.

classification.summary: Use when the request is about job descriptions, interview planning, candidate screening, hiring rubrics, offer preparation, or pipeline management.

label: Procurement

label: Scientist

classification.summary: Use when the request is about scientific reasoning, experimental design, evidence review, method critique, protocol writing, or literature synthesis.

label: Health
description: General health information, symptom-safety triage, care-navigation support, and wellness explanations.
